notes.title: Skin achievement patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed skin achievements.
[*] If you have any unlocked skins with missing achievements, just select them in the wardrobe.
[*] The frog skin is now available to buy for players with The Circle ending already unlocked.
[/list]

notes.title: Big Halloween update
Preparing for the Halloween update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It’s been a while since we last checked in, but we’ve got plenty to share.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43681990/01ec738028ff0243fee82e12a0cbcaead46290d7.gif[/img]

As you may have noticed, for those who achieved [b]100%[/b] completion in Steam, the game is no longer listed as perfect. This happened because we’re preparing a big free update, which will include new quests, skins for the witch, an opening cutscene, cloud saves, and, of course, achievements.
It’s expected to be released around Halloween, so you can spend a spooky night in good witch company and unlock those new achievements.

notes.title: The cow patch!
notes.notes:
Includes: 
[list]
[*] major background update to support all sorts of displays, wide and square alike!
[*] basic controller support with a virtual cursor, mostly targeted at Steam Deck users. We'll continue working on gamepad usability in later patches - please send us your feedback and ideas!
[*] storyline cooldowns for smoother story flow.
[*] additional storylines and events for the guy who wants to steal some eggs, the guy who wants to turn manure into gold, the guy who wants to find the meaning of life, and the cow.  
[*] some night event and other art update. 
[*] fixed the fireplace animation.
[*] changed the face on the rejuvenation bottle (It was me, Dio).
[/list]

notes.title: The bishop patch
notes.notes:
Cauldron 1.6 patch notes:

[list]
[*] The True Power ending fix, made the ending easier to unlock.
[*] Fixed ending map icons and animation.
[*] Some updates to Experiments tab - now the sets are clickable.
[*] Fixed experiments data not cleared on Reset Progress.
[*] Some storyline distribution across rounds (for those who are tired of the vampire storyline).
[*] You can now pick the default skin and make the witch jump at any time.
[*] Fixed music stopping in the menu.
[*] Some art and character updates.
[/list]
